newsitem.title: USA: Interim sees meeting Q4 expectations.
newsitem.headline: Interim sees meeting Q4 expectations.

text.p: Interim Services Inc said on Friday it expects fourth quarter earnings to be in line with analysts' consensus estimates of $0.50-$0.53 a share, and it knows of no reason for the decline in its stock price yesterday.
Interim closed down 3-1/8 at 36 on Thursday.
The company said analysts' consensus earnings estimates of $2.05-$2.10 a share for 1997 are consistent with its plans for next year.
Interim said its fundamentals remain unchanged, and gross profit and operating margins remain stable. It said it anticipates a positive environment moving into 1997.
